I booked an appointment for a cryotherapy session. Just a couple of hours before my appointment I was told on the phone that the machine was broken so I needed to book an appointment next week. I thought it was understandable even though I believed they could have told me way earlier.

I told my employer about my next appointment so I could attend the clinic. Just on the day of my appointment, I received a call but wasn't given an opportunity to answer and listen because as soon as the call came in it just ended in a second. Not even another call. A few minutes later I received a message with a vague excuse mentioning 'unforeseen circumstances' and was asked to get in the long queue and book another appointment. No reason why. I am very disappointed as this was a waste of my time and interfered with my work and risked leaving an impression on my employer that I am making up excuses to skip in person work.     I would have appreciated a honest explanation with alternative arrangement whether it's the GP taking initiative to offer me another appropriate appointment instead of me having to call them again as this was second time cancellation from GP or offering a referral to another GP for the treatment if required and appropriate. And I believe it is reasonable to ask to communicate a few days in advance if it is expected the treatment was not possible instead of telling the patient at the last minute and expect the patient to deal whatever consequences.

Do better!

Because of this I do not have any confidence I will receive the treatment I wanted in a timely fashion, therefore I am going back to my previous
